subject: Oceanography
title: The Collapse of Cod
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Collapse of Cod.

hook.text: In 1992, Canada closed its cod fishery—a stock that once seemed inexhaustible had collapsed by 99%.

buildup.text: Atlantic cod fed Europe for 500 years—John Cabot said you could walk on their backs in 1497.

discovery.text: Industrial trawlers after WWII harvested cod at unsustainable rates—catches peaked in the 1960s then plummeted.

twist.text: Even after 30+ years of fishing ban, cod stocks have barely recovered—the ecosystem shifted to a new state.

climax.text: 40,000 people lost their jobs overnight—the largest layoff in Canadian history, devastating entire communities.

punchline.text: We fished until there were none—and the sea hasn't forgiven us.

quiz.question: What happened to Atlantic cod stocks by 1992?
